lead.claim: For DPN patients, prioritize Swiss Ball over Wobble Board for balance and mobility.
lead.context: Why this matters: *Swiss Ball exercises led to greater improvements than Wobble Board exercises for balance, mobility, and functional independence in patients with diabetic peripheral neuropathy.

supporting.claim: Does oxygen fraction change HIIT outcomes for active men?
supporting.context: Why this matters: *Hyperoxic high-intensity interval training was associated with broader aerobic improvements and lower post-exercise lactate compared to hypoxic training in active men.

supporting.claim: A digital system is feasible for shoulder rehabilitation.
supporting.context: Why this matters: *A web- and mobile-supported semi-automated shoulder rehabilitation system was feasible to implement and associated with reduced clinical deficit scores.

supporting.claim: Immersive VR is a safe option for post-stroke upper limb rehab.
supporting.context: Why this matters: *An immersive virtual reality system was found feasible and safe for upper-extremity rehabilitation in stroke patients during a single session.

supporting.claim: A multi-component intervention may help reduce sedentary behavior in SCI.
supporting.context: Why this matters: *A sedentary behavior intervention for wheelchair users with spinal cord injury was found acceptable, safe, and feasible, with preliminary efficacy.
